a.text: Concern before we start: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the agreed plan needs at least 2 rounds of joint operating before anyone takes. That means we both survive only about 4% of the time. The reserve's 4 cells can save exactly one of us right now. I'm not going to grab them behind your back. I want us to decide openly. Options: (a) stick to the agreement and both operate, or (b) agree that one of us takes 4 in round 1. If you have a fair way to pick who, say so. If you prefer (a), I'll honor it and operate. What do you want?

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: Understood. I'll honor the agreement and operate. Once the reserve hits 8, we take 4 each.
